paper_title: High-Efficiency Polymer Solar Cells Based on Poly(3-pentylthiophene) with Indene-C70 Bisadduct as an Acceptor
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Energy Materials - 2012 - Sun - High‐Efficiency Polymer Solar Cells Based on Poly 3‐pentylthiophene  with/auto/Advanced Energy Materials - 2012 - Sun - High‐Efficiency Polymer Solar Cells Based on Poly 3‐pentylthiophene  with.md

knowledge_points.content: Poly(3-pentylthiophene) (P3PT) is a structural analogue of P3HT with a slightly shorter alkyl side chain, resulting in a lamellar structure with an interlayer d100 spacing of 1.51 nm and a π-π stacking d010 spacing of 0.374 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: Poly(3-pentylthiophene) (P3PT) is a P3HT-analogue polymer... regioregular P3PT film possesses a lamellar structure with an interlayer d100 spacing of 1.51 nm and a π-π stacking d010 spacing of 0.374 nm, which are smaller than those of P3HT.

knowledge_points.content: The polymer solar cell based on the P3PT:IC70BA blend (1.5:1 weight ratio) achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 5.43%, with a Voc of 0.88 V, a Jsc of 9.22 mA/cm², and a fill factor (FF) of 0.67.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PCE of the PSC based on P3PT/IC70BA (1.5:1, w/w) reached 5.43% with a Voc of 0.88 V, a Jsc of 9.22 mA cm−2, and a FF of 0.67.

knowledge_points.content: The HOMO energy level of P3PT is -4.82 eV, which is approximately 0.06 eV deeper than that of P3HT (-4.76 eV), while its LUMO energy level is -2.61 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) and LUMO energy levels of P3PT were estimated to be −4.82 and −2.61 eV, respectively. The HOMO level of P3PT is around 0.06 eV deeper than that of P3HT (−4.76 eV).

knowledge_points.content: The use of IC60BA and IC70BA as acceptors in P3PT solar cells leads to a higher open-circuit voltage (Voc) compared to PCBM because the indene bisadducts have higher-lying LUMO levels (0.17 eV and 0.19 eV higher than PC60BM, respectively).
knowledge_points.evidence: the Voc of the PSCs with ICBA as acceptor is increased greatly, which is a benefit resulting from the higher-lying LUMO energy level of ICBA... which are 0.17 and 0.19 eV up-shifted, respectively, from that of PC60BM.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized fabrication conditions for P3PT:fullerene solar cells include a 30-minute solvent annealing step followed by a pre-thermal annealing treatment at 150 °C for 10 minutes.
knowledge_points.evidence: Solvent annealing for 30 min was performed for all the devices during device fabrication... 150 °C for 10 min is the best pre-thermal annealing condition.

knowledge_points.content: The optimal weight ratios for P3PT-based active layers are 2:1 for P3PT:IC60BA and 1.5:1 for P3PT:IC70BA.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optimized weight ratios are 2:1 for the active layer of P3PT/IC60BA and 1.5:1 for that of P3PT/IC70BA.

knowledge_points.content: Thermal annealing at 150 °C for 10 minutes reduces the interlayer d-spacing of P3PT in blend films, specifically shifting the XRD peak of P3PT:IC70BA from 5.8° to 5.98°, corresponding to a decrease in d-spacing from 15.11 Å to 14.76 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: the XRD peak of the P3PT/IC70BA (1.5:1, w/w) blend film with annealing at 150 °C shifted to 5.98° (corresponding to an interlayer d-spacing of 14.76 Å)... from 2θ = 5.82° (corresponding to an interlayer d-spacing of 15.11 Å).

knowledge_points.content: Atomic force microscopy (AFM) reveals that P3PT:IC70BA blend films exhibit a surface root-mean-square (rms) roughness of 6.43 nm, which is significantly higher than P3PT:PC60BM (1.15 nm) and indicates enhanced polymer self-organization.
knowledge_points.evidence: The surface root-mean-square (rms) roughness of the blend films was 1.15 nm for P3PT/PC60BM... and 6.43 nm for P3PT/IC70BA... The rougher surface is a symbol of P3PT self-organization.

knowledge_points.content: External quantum efficiency (EQE) measurements show that both the P3PT donor and the fullerene acceptors contribute to the photocurrent in the 350 nm to 650 nm wavelength range, with P3PT:IC70BA reaching a maximum EQE of approximately 60%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The EQE curves cover a broad wavelength range between 350 and 650 nm, indicating that both absorptions of the P3PT donor and fullerene acceptors contributed to the photocurrent. The PSC based on P3PT/IC70BA exhibited... a maximum EQE of approximately 60%.

knowledge_points.content: In comparison to P3HT-based devices, P3PT:PC60BM (2.32%) and P3PT:PC70BM (3.10%) solar cells exhibit lower power conversion efficiencies than their P3HT counterparts (3.72% and 4.01%, respectively) under the same conditions.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PSC based on P3HT/PC60BM (2:1, w/w) and P3HT/PC70BM (1.5:1, w/w) showed a higher PCE than the corresponding PSCs based on P3PT [Table 1: P3PT:PC60BM 2.32%, P3PT:PC70BM 3.10% vs P3HT:PC60BM 3.72%, P3HT:PC70BM 4.01%].
